challenge.better_approach: Waiting longer would hide the case rather than name it; the gate can take any time, so naming silence as silence is the smaller true fix.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a timeout means the gate may still cross; a gate that is down also times out, and the message says only that it did not answer.
challenge.prior_art: ticket 239740d9db04 separated a refusal from a missing handler in queueme's trouble; this does the same at sail.py's mouth.
challenge.real_collision: None: close.sh's own comment demands the commit name what the gate did.

answers.falsifier: Done when (1) a clearance whose bus request raises TimeoutError makes sail.py cross return 3 and say 'did not answer', and never 'refused'; (2) a clearance answering accepted False still makes sail.py cross return 1 and say 'refused' with the gate's reason; (3) close.sh names an RC 3 crossing 'clearance unanswered' and exits 3, and its 'PROVED refused' commit is reached only on another non-zero RC.
answers.from_idea: none, because the defect is measured on the close of ticket 8c5fdb750b75
answers.how: sail.py cross: when queueme's reply carries an error and no accepted key (Ticket.queueme puts {'error': str(exc)} there on a TimeoutError), print 'clearance did not answer <id> within <N>s: the gate may still cross it; the ticket's cursor is the record' and return 3. A reply with accepted False still prints 'clearance refused' and returns 1. close.sh: RC 3 commits as 'clearance unanswered', prints how to read the cursor, and exits 3. The proof drives sail.cross with a bus that raises TimeoutError, shaped like cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_sail_queues_the_ticket_at_codemothers_gates.py.
answers.traces_to: Law 7 (errors are permanent and true in records of truth; a commit message is one) and close.sh's own rule: the commit is named for what the gate did, never for what was asked.
answers.what: sail.py cross says a clearance that never answered inside its wait is unanswered, not refused, and exits 3; close.sh names that commit 'clearance unanswered' and points at the ticket's cursor, which is the record.

bullets.text: A clearance that times out now reads 'unanswered' (exit 3), not 'refused': 8c5fdb750b75's 'refused' was the gate still working.
